# Dr. Harshil Shah — Orthopaedic Surgeon & Joint Specialist

> Dr. Harshil Shah is an orthopaedic surgeon in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, specialising in knee, hip, and shoulder conditions, including robotic-assisted joint replacement, keyhole arthroscopy, joint preservation, and sports injury rehabilitation.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://drharshilshah.com/): Overview of clinical services, doctor credentials, patient testimonials, and appointment booking.
- [About Dr. Harshil Shah](https://drharshilshah.com/about): Medical qualifications (MBBS, MS Orthopaedics), international fellowship training at Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS, New York) and Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH, Boston).
- [Treatments & Specialisations](https://drharshilshah.com/treatments): Detailed procedures for knee replacement, hip preservation, shoulder arthroscopy, ACL reconstruction, and rotator cuff repairs.
- [Patient Education Guides](https://drharshilshah.com/patient-guides): Comprehensive recovery protocols, pre-op instructions, and joint wellness tips.
- [Surgical Videos & OT Insights](https://drharshilshah.com/surgical-videos): Video guides and surgical explanations of minimally invasive procedures.
- [Brochures & Resources](https://drharshilshah.com/brochures): Downloadable joint care booklets and surgical preparation brochures.
- [Patient Care Gallery](https://drharshilshah.com/gallery): Clinical milestones, patient recovery journeys, and clinic infrastructure.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://drharshilshah.com/faq): Over 40 verified patient questions on consultations, costs, recovery times, and second opinions.

## Clinical Specialties
- Robotic Knee Replacement & Knee Arthroscopy (ACL/Meniscus)
- Muscle-Sparing Hip Replacement & Avascular Necrosis (AVN) Treatment
- Shoulder Arthroscopy, Rotator Cuff Repair & Shoulder Replacement
- Sports Injuries, Cartilage Restoration & Joint Preservation
